title: Engine diagnosis — 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
I use this page as a signpost at a diagnostic fork. Basic mechanical concerns lead to the general engine diagnostic reference; driveability concerns lead to the powertrain-control diagnostic manual. Choosing the right lane comes before chasing the problem around the engine bay.

This page identifies where to continue. The referenced procedures supply the diagnostic work; no test setup, measurements or result-based decisions are reproduced here.

edits.text:
For basic mechanical concerns, refer to Engine (303-00 Engine System - General Information, Diagnosis and Testing).

For driveability concerns, refer to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual.
edits.why: These are separate diagnostic routes. Selecting a reference does not establish the cause of the concern; the next work comes from the applicable diagnostic material.
